<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent/><name>autoAdvancePlaybookActivity</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Hook for playbook card auto-advance. The ITEM_FINISHED wiring below is the
 * hard-won part: the event MUST be referenced as
 * now_playbook_exp.PLAYBOOK#ITEM_FINISHED (scope-prefixed) or the handler
 * silently never runs, and the event fires several times per action so it has to
 * be de-duplicated.
 *
 * The refresh action itself is still unsolved - see
 * SCRIPTS/PLAYBOOK_NESTED_FINDINGS.md section 7 for everything already ruled out
 * (report-only selection prop, sandboxed client scripts, navigate.to opening a new
 * tab, isHidden remount not refetching, api.emit and an EVENT-target mapping of
 * AMB_UPDATE_RECEIVED both having no effect).
 *
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (!event || event.name !== 'PLAYBOOK#ITEM_FINISHED') {
        return;
    }
    var finishedId = (event.payload || {}).activityContextId;
    if (!finishedId) {
        return;
    }

    var seen = '';
    try {
        seen = api.state.currentActivityContextId || '';
    } catch (e) {
        seen = '';
    }
    if (seen === finishedId) {
        return;
    }
    api.setState('currentActivityContextId', finishedId);

    /* eslint-disable-next-line no-console */
    console.log('[AUTOADVANCE] activity finished:', finishedId);
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-06 19:34:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>8b7ca9ed832243106b0fc4e0deaad345</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>autoAdvancePlaybookActivity</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Policy Suite" source="x_gegis_ins_policy">43b656ac3bdd8b1005ad7564c3e45a73</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Policy Suite">43b656ac3bdd8b1005ad7564c3e45a73</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8b7ca9ed832243106b0fc4e0deaad345</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-06 20:55:10</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
